overview: Third year is the bridge to professional engineering. In this year, you develop one deep specialization (Full-Stack, AI/ML, Cloud/DevOps, or Cybersecurity), build Tier-1 resume projects with production architecture, study Computer Networks, prepare your 1-page ATS resume, and apply for 3rd-year summer internships.
keyGoals: Choose and master ONE core specialization track (Web/Cloud, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Data).
Build 2 high-impact Tier-1 resume projects with caching (Redis), message queues, and cloud deployment.
Master Computer Networks (OSI, TCP/IP, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, DNS, WebSockets).
Complete a 1-page ATS-compliant engineering resume using the Google XYZ formula.
Solve 250+ DSA questions and start practicing Mock Technical Interviews.
Secure a 3rd-year summer internship via campus hiring or off-campus cold outreach.

subjects.name: Computer Networks (CN & Internet Protocols)
subjects.importance: Critical - Evaluated in all backend, cloud, systems, and full-stack interviews
coreConcepts: OSI 7-Layer Model & TCP/IP Architecture
Application Layer: HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, FTP, SMTP, WebSockets, gRPC
Transport Layer: TCP (3-Way Handshake, Flow Control with Sliding Window, Congestion Control) vs UDP
Network Layer: IPv4 vs IPv6, Subnetting & CIDR, Routing Protocols (OSPF, BGP)
Link Layer & Physical: MAC Addressing, ARP, Ethernet, Switching vs Routing
Network Security: TLS/SSL Handshake, Certificates, Symmetric vs Asymmetric Cryptography, Firewalls

recommendedBooks.title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach
recommendedBooks.author: James F. Kurose & Keith W. Ross (UMass Amherst)
recommendedChapters: Chapter 1: Computer Networks and the Internet
Chapter 2: Application Layer (HTTP, DNS, Socket Programming)
Chapter 3: Transport Layer (Principles of Reliable Data Transfer, TCP)
Chapter 4-5: Network Layer: Data Plane and Control Plane
recommendedBooks.whyRead: The single best networking book in the world, starting from user applications down to physical wires.

recommendedProjects.title: Real-Time Distributed Collaborative Document Editor (Google Docs Clone)
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Multiple users editing the same document simultaneously cause conflicting edits and race conditions without conflict resolution.
keyFeatures: Real-time synchronized text editing across multiple connected clients with cursor presence.
Conflict-free replicated data types (CRDT / Yjs) or Operational Transformation algorithm preventing text scrambling.
Redis Pub/Sub layer allowing horizontal scaling across multiple backend socket servers.
Document revision history with time-travel rewind and version snapshots.

recommendedProjects.title: Production E-Commerce Platform with Microservices & Payment Gateway
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Large e-commerce systems require decoupled services (Auth, Product Catalog, Order Processing, Payment, Notification) that do not bring down the entire website during flash sales.
keyFeatures: Decoupled services communicating via REST APIs and asynchronous Kafka events (e.g. `OrderCreated` triggers payment and inventory reservation).
Redis caching on high-read product catalog endpoints reducing DB load by 70%.
Distributed transaction handling (Saga pattern) handling failed payment rollbacks.
Full test suite with Jest / Supertest and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline deploying Docker containers.

recommendedProjects.title: End-to-End AI Medical Document & X-Ray Analysis SaaS
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Automate preliminary clinical report analysis and chest X-ray disease detection to assist triage staff in hospitals.
keyFeatures: Fine-tuned Convolutional Neural Network (ResNet-50 / EfficientNet) classifying 14 common chest conditions (e.g., Pneumonia, Cardiomegaly).
Grad-CAM visual heatmap overlay showing exactly which lung region influenced the model's prediction.
FastAPI async inference endpoint containerized in Docker with <120ms P99 latency.
OCR text extraction summarizing key patient vitals from scanned medical reports.

recommendedProjects.title: Distributed Cloud File Storage with Chunking & Deduplication (Dropbox Clone)
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Uploading large files repeatedly wastes cloud bandwidth and storage if multiple users upload identical file copies.
keyFeatures: Client-side file splitting into 4MB chunks and computing content-based SHA-256 hashes.
Content-addressable storage deduplication (stores duplicate blocks only once).
Resumable multipart uploads surviving network disconnections.
Time-limited presigned S3 download URLs for secure file sharing.

recommendedProjects.title: Automated Vulnerability Scanner & Penetration Testing Tool
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Companies need automated tools to scan target domains for open ports, outdated SSL versions, exposed `.env` files, and standard OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
keyFeatures: Asynchronous TCP/UDP port scanner benchmarking 1,000 ports in <5 seconds using async sockets.
Automated header auditor checking for CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, and CORS misconfigurations.
SQL injection (SQLi) and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payload injector detecting unescaped parameters.
Generates clean PDF security audit reports with severity scores (CVSS metrics).

actionSteps: 1. Finalize 1-Page ATS Resume with 2 Tier-1 Projects (Google XYZ format).
2. Complete 200+ LeetCode DSA questions (focus on Graphs, Trees, and DP).
3. Build active LinkedIn profile: post weekly project learnings and connect with 50+ campus alumni & engineers.
4. Prepare STAR behavioral answers (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for 10 common HR questions.
5. Apply systematically to 50+ companies (on-campus portal, referrals via LinkedIn alumni, AngelList/Wellfound for funded startups).

tasks: Read Kurose & Ross CN Chapters 1 to 3 (HTTP, DNS, TCP Handshake & Flow Control).
Start chosen Specialization Track (Full-Stack, AI/ML, Cloud, or Cyber).
Solve 30 advanced DSA questions on Graphs and Shortest Paths.
Architect and start Project 1 (e.g. Distributed Collaborative Editor or E-Commerce Microservices).
Implement Redis caching, database indexing, and Docker containerization.
Deploy MVP live on cloud with public demo URL and detailed GitHub README.
Watch Gaurav Sen / ByteByteGo System Design videos (Load Balancers, Caching, Sharding).
Conduct 16-point ATS resume audit using the CSE Resume Master Guide.
Conduct 3 mock technical interviews with peers on CoderPad/Google Docs.
Apply to summer internship openings via referral and college TPO portal.
Revise Operating Systems, DBMS, and Computer Networks rapid-fire questions.
Complete second Tier-1 project and polish GitHub commits.
